features: Unmodified mainline TWL6032 GPADC IIO driver
dt_changes: One PMIC gpadc child, ti,twl6032-gpadc, logical IRQ3, io-channel-cells1
Enable existing OMAP4460 PMU wrapper and retain its debug-clock branch; preserve native IRQ54/55; CPU1 stays disabled
hardware_changes: ADC measurement-input enables, ADC EOC masks and the debug clock branch only. No regulator/GPIO/rate policy changes.

stock_observations.pmic_misc1: 0x00: internal VBAT/backup/VAC voltage paths disabled; calibrated internal voltages cannot be compared directly to this state
stock_observations.usb_vbus_id_control: 0x04/0x14; upstream uses SET aliases with bit0 only
stock_observations.adc_otp: 16 nonzero per-chip trim bytes saved, read-only
stock_observations.pmu: Cycle counting works in stock; instructions and overflow samples zero. Per-mode exclusions rejected on Cortex-A9. No secure-debug bypass planned.

test_scope.adc_api: IIO processed millivolts, EOC IRQ progress, OTP-derived calibration, repeat conversions
test_scope.pmu: Cycle/instruction count and overflow sample records; report any stock-like hardware limitations explicitly
test_scope.integrity: 65 sampled supply fields, GPIO port, clock fields, Qt PID/display/audio binary, no eMMC mounts/writes
test_scope.recovery: Hardware-watchdog expiry to healthy stock; exact factory p8 and original measurement registers after boot

display: Reuse ram99 display/input/audio qualification; no blank/unblank or Qt restart tests
